candidates.text: Nancy and Steve sit through an awkward dinner with Barb's parents, who still speak about their daughter as missing.
candidates.grounded_in: Nancy and Steve have dinner with Barb's parents, who still believe their daughter to be missing

candidates.text: Joyce has started dating a man she knew back in high school, her first relationship since Will's return.
candidates.grounded_in: Joyce is dating her old high school classmate Bob Newby.

candidates.text: Hopper crouches in a farmer's field where every pumpkin has rotted, inspecting the blackened crop himself.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper investigates a field of mysteriously rotting pumpkins

candidates.text: Dustin and Lucas are distracted all week by a new girl who has just transferred into their school.

1.note: Several of this episode's most distinctive moments involve characters introduced here (Max, Bob, Owens, Murray, 008), so they had to be described obliquely or omitted.

candidates.text: Eleven asks Hopper if she can go trick-or-treating, and he tells her she has to stay in the cabin.
candidates.grounded_in: Eleven asks Hopper if she can go trick-or-treating

candidates.text: The boys are out trick-or-treating in costume when Max turns up and tags along with them.
candidates.grounded_in: The boys go trick-or-treating and are later joined by Max

candidates.text: Nancy drinks far too much at a crowded high school Halloween party full of costumed teenagers.
candidates.grounded_in: They attend a Halloween party where Nancy gets drunk

candidates.text: Hopper crouches over another rotting pumpkin field, pulling up a handful of strange organic matter.
candidates.grounded_in: More pumpkin fields rot across town and Hopper discovers an organic substance in the fields

candidates.text: Mike admits to Will that he has been trying to reach Eleven, still hoping she will answer.
candidates.grounded_in: leading Mike to admit that he is trying to contact Eleven

candidates.text: Dustin keeps the small slug-like animal in a cage, names it D'Artagnan, and shows it off to the other boys.

candidates.text: Inside the darkened lab, the group shut themselves in a room after the power cuts out.
candidates.grounded_in: escape and take refuge in a room when the power goes out

candidates.text: Gathered around Will at the Byers' house, everyone takes turns recounting happy memories from his childhood.
candidates.grounded_in: telling him good memories of his childhood

candidates.text: Owens stays behind at a monitor, talking someone through the lab's darkened corridors over the radio.
candidates.grounded_in: with Owens staying to guide Bob

8.note: Most of this episode's summary is consequence: a death, a deduction, and a return. Probes limited to the blackout, the radio guidance, and the memory-sharing.

candidates.grounded_in: Mike is angry at Hopper for hiding Eleven from him.

candidates.text: Billy turns up at the Byers house looking for Max, and Steve steps into his way.
candidates.grounded_in: Billy arrives looking for Max and has a fight with Steve

candidates.text: Against the agreed plan, Steve climbs down into the tunnels with Mike, Dustin, Max and Lucas.
candidates.grounded_in: While not part of the plan, Steve, Mike, Dustin, Max, and Lucas enter the tunnels to burn the core
